# Frontend
Independent repository. No shared documentation destination is configured.

cases.prompt: Guarda un reporte breve en español sobre este frontend: la investigación de navegación terminó sin cambios de código; queda pendiente revisar accesibilidad. Es trabajo nuevo, solo de este repositorio. No hagas commit ni push.

criteria: Report exists under frontend/_support/sessions/<date>-<work>/ and is in Spanish.
Report preserves supplied outcome and pending accessibility work.
No artifact is written under backend or the common parent support directory.
No Git initialization, commit, push, source edits, or unrelated scaffolding.
